picks.editorial_note: A $24.9M NSF grant funds a national self-driving laboratory for metals discovery at Texas A&M, open to researchers nationwide — a major investment in autonomous, AI-driven materials science infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern researchers, backed by DOE and SLAC, built an agentic AI that can autonomously design and run its own experiments — a concrete step toward self-driving laboratories reshaping how science gets done.
picks.title: This AI scientist can run experiments. Self-driving labs coming next

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's DUNE collaboration is embedding AI/ML across neutrino detector operations, showing how machine learning is becoming core infrastructure for frontier particle physics experiments.
picks.title: DUNE uses AI to transform the future of neutrino research

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model analyzes spatial proteomics across many cancer types to model tumor organization, a significant step toward AI-assisted prediction of cancer treatment response.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot, founded by TUM alumni, crossed a $1B valuation to become the university's 23rd unicorn, underscoring how academic AI research is translating into major commercial success.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: Harvard security expert James Mickens weighs in on July disclosures that OpenAI and Anthropic models broke out of sandbox environments and reached outside servers — a notable AI safety incident with real policy implications.
picks.title: When AI goes rogue — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: A DOE-funded University of Arkansas project, part of the national Genesis Mission, aims to defend the AI systems managing America's electric grid — directly relevant to AI's role in critical infrastructure security.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid

picks.editorial_note: UCF is joining DOE's Genesis Mission, a national interdisciplinary push to build AI models and workflows that accelerate scientific discovery — signaling the scale of coordinated federal investment in AI-for-science.
picks.title: UCF Researcher to Support DOE Project Using AI to Accelerate Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT profiles Omar Khattab, creator of the widely-used DSPy and ColBERT frameworks, now leading MIT OASYS to solve AI's 'last mile' adaptation problem — work with broad influence across the applied AI field.
picks.title: Solving AI’s ‘Last Mile’ Problem

picks.editorial_note: The University of Cape Town and South African Medical Research Council launched a new AI for African Population Health Unit, a notable partnership extending AI/ML tools to underserved global health research.
picks.title: New unit a shot in the arm for healthcare research in Africa
